what: The Operator Seat is a worker's chair: machines that need an operator draw seconds of work from seats in range, and the worker eats food (nutrition times 120 s by default). Research packs 1 to 7 are the items the Age gates consume.

connects.items: ItemHandler capability on the seat (food only, insert only)
connects.machines: data/diaithircrafting/machine_stats.json holds W and s per Foundry machine
connects.research: datapack/foundry_ages holds the Age gate research nodes (Researcher #127)
